summary: Frontend-only verification of My Library vs Order History separation. Admin (overflowharvest@gmail.com) login + skip-2FA worked. /my-library 'My Content' card shows exactly 10 active entitlements (badges: 1 Processing, 1 Awaiting fulfillment, 8 Available) with the new subtitle 'Active content you own and can access right now.' plus header order-history-btn and in-card library-order-history-link both navigating to /order-history. /order-history (NEW) renders exactly 14 order rows (11 Pending + 3 Completed) with order-row-<num>, order-status-<status>, order-total-<num> testids and the subtitle 'A complete, permanent record of every order you've placed...' Bidirectional nav works: back-to-library-btn and go-to-library-link both return to /my-library; order-history-btn and library-order-history-link both go to /order-history. SEPARATION proven: 11 Pending orders appear in Order History but NONE of them are usable items in Library (Library count 10 != History count 14).
critical_code_review_comments: MyLibrary.js is 842 lines — consider splitting into smaller components (header, content card, redeem card, rewards card) for maintainability. Threshold >700 lines per code review guidelines.
All required data-testids are present and stable. No hardcoded URLs detected in OrderHistory.js/MyLibrary.js navigation.
